newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania Banca Agricola lowers leu deposit rates.
newsitem.headline: Romania Banca Agricola lowers leu deposit rates.

text.p: Romanian state-owned bank Banca Agricola SA said it had lowered interest rates on individuals' leu deposits starting on Monday.
A bank statement showed the annual rate on one-month deposits dropped to 110 percent from 115 percent, with the rate on three-month deposits falling to 112 percent from 116 percent annually.
The move follows recent drops in money market rates due to leu overliquidity.
Six- and nine-month deposits carry a yearly rate of 113 percent, down from 117 percent, while the annual rate on one-year deposits slid to 114 percent from 118 percent.
Banca Agricola farm lender is a leading bank likely to turn private under a bank selloff bill which cleared parliament earlier this year.
